subject: Hosted API evaluation follow-up & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Suneel Rao <suneel@finpay.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API evaluation follow-up & next steps

Hi Suneel 

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

What we covered
- Redwood Hosted API is the fastest way to validate integration (no infra required). You get: token-based auth, regional endpoints, streaming responses, embeddings, and function/tool-calling support.
- We demoed a sample chat integration and the prefix-caching behavior that reduces cost for repeated prompts.

Hosted API quickstart (recommended for PoC)
1) Sign up / create sandbox API key: https://console.redwood.ai/signup
2) Use sandbox key: REDWOOD_SANDBOX_KEY_REDACTED in your dev environment
3) Test endpoints (examples):
   - Chat: POST https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
   - Text generation: POST https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/generate
   - Embeddings: POST https://api.eu.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
4) Suggested test plan: 1) replicate your typical chat flow, 2) run embedding quality checks on 100 sample docs, 3) measure 95th pct latency on 1k requests.

Default sandbox limits & upgrade path
- Sandbox (default) rate limits: 60 requests/minute, up to 5 concurrent streaming connections.
- Production hosted limits are configurable (higher rate limits & quotas) and can be increased as part of a paid plan. If you need strict throughput SLOs and reserved GPU capacity, Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) is the next step.

Attachments included: redwood-hosted-quickstart.pdf (quickstart + curl examples), SLA-overview.pdf (high-level SLA + region support), onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Next steps
- Can you confirm the approximate QPS / requests-per-minute you expect for the PoC and whether EU data residency is required?
- If preferred, I can schedule a 60-min technical onboarding with Ava (SE) to walk through the quickstart and your network/config needs.

I can also pull pricing and Dedicated vs Hosted capacity comparisons once I have throughput targets.

Thanks 
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Suneel Rao <suneel@finpay.com>

Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation follow-up & next steps

Hi Marissa 

Appreciate the recap. Couple quick clarifications before we start: 
1) Our primary requirement for the PoC is EU data residency (all customer PII stays in EU). You mentioned eu endpoints does Hosted API guarantee data stays in the EU region and is not replicated to the US?
2) We expect a baseline of ~120 requests/min during peak hour for the initial rollout, with bursts up to ~300 req/min for short periods. Does that fit in the Hosted plan or should we plan for Dedicated?
3) Any constraints around VPC/network peering for talking to our internal services?

If Hosted supports EU-only residency and can handle the burst profile with an upgraded quota, we'd prefer the quicker path (Hosted) for the initial integration. Otherwise we may need to evaluate Dedicated.

Would like to run the quickstart next week if we can get the sandbox key and an SE session.

Best,
Suneel
Head of Product, FinPay
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Suneel Rao <suneel@finpay.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation follow-up & next steps

Thanks Suneel  good questions, answers below: 

1) EU data residency
- Hosted API supports region-specific endpoints and ensures request handling & logs are stored in the selected region (we currently offer eu-west-1 and eu-central-1). For customers with strict residency needs we can enable EU-only processing and audit logs; this is part of the standard Hosted offering (no Dedicated contract required). I'll attach the SLA doc and region specifics (see SLA-overview.pdf).

2) Throughput & bursting
- For the volumes you quoted (120 rpm baseline, 300 rpm bursts), Hosted can support that with a quota increase and burst buffer for many customers. If you require guaranteed reserved throughput and lower tail latency with an SLA for peak capacity, Dedicated is the right path (reserved GPU pools + autoscaling policies).
- Recommendation: start with Hosted (prod tier) and request a production quota uplift to cover 300 rpm burst. If sustained throughput requirements grow (sustained GPU hours), we can present a Dedicated proposal.

3) VPC / network connectivity
- Hosted supports VPC peering and PrivateLink-type options for enterprise customers on certain plans; for fully private on-prem or air-gapped needs we offer Redwood Private (on-prem/VPC) which is a separate deployment. If you need VPC peering for the PoC, Ava (cc'd) can share the network requirements checklist.

Attached: onboarding-checklist.xlsx (network + auth checklist), SLA-overview.pdf. Also sharing a sandbox key via console after you confirm the account email.

Proposed next steps: 
- Confirm which EU region you prefer (eu-west-1 or eu-central-1).
- Confirm a PoC start window next week and I'll book a 60-min SE onboarding with Ava.
- I'll request a production quota uplift to cover 300 rpm burst; Aditya will follow up on pricing and pilot terms.

If that sounds good I'll schedule the SE session for Mon/Tue next week.

Cheers,
Marissa
